checks.claim: Editing a label preserves the persisted forecast amount
checks.counterexample: Initialize the editor from effective amount instead of forecast
checks.expected_failure: Persisted forecast differs after saving only the label

checks.claim: A negative forecast amount is refused
tests: refuses a negative forecast with INVALID_AMOUNT
checks.counterexample: Accept any number as a forecast
checks.expected_failure: Saving -10 as forecast succeeds instead of returning INVALID_AMOUNT

checks.claim: Two concurrent sign-ups with the same email create one account
scenario_refs: accounts/A second account with a taken email is refused
checks.counterexample: Check the email is free, then insert, with no unique constraint between the two
checks.expected_failure: Both racing sign-ups succeed and two accounts share the email instead of one EMAIL_TAKEN

round_trip.invariant: Forecast amount is unchanged after saving a different field

concurrent_invariants.invariant: At most one account holds a given email
scenario_refs: accounts/A second account with a taken email is refused
